description.en:
Opens the ambient sound of the current map, read from the map's MAP_ENV data (SndEnv entry), and returns its handle. Start it with CMND_SND_PLAY.
During a match, and when the optional argument is not true, it does not open anything: it returns the same match-state BGM name string as CMND_SND_GET_DEF_BGMID (the code of the two functions matches there).
true to use the map's value even during a match.

Handle of the ambient sound.
During a match (without forceMap): a string, see the description.
null if the map has no ambient sound, or if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Starting the map's ambience in a scene (real usage, from ev42093000.nut)
